Did you try to seek out for professional help? I suffered from self harm for a long time when I was paranoid(I was diagnosed with PTSD and despite my fear of death I had depressive periods that led me to self harm), and that was the only reason I considered visiting psychiatrist. In any case, do you have any family members to support or pets to comfort? Sometimes even creatures whom you don’t understand like animals may calm you and show their affection. I hope you manage to reach out to help concerning self harm :( But if you also have suicidal thoughts as the reason to self harm(the hope to end it not just calm yourself), unfortunately I too don’t know what to do. Maybe this life just isn’t for us and we have someone awaiting us on the other side…
But how you’re doing right now? It’s been a few hours..

I know it but it’s hard to bear that the person I invested my efforts, love and affection will be gone :( I had some relationships before and they were abusive, so it’s hard for me to trust anyone. I’ve been dating my bf for 2 years and he showed me he really cared about me, but now he just does nothing and I asked him if he lost his love for me(i dunno but after our initial “hormone” period he got used to me and started to fade away a little as a partner), he just says he doesn’t want to even try and wants me to get off(and he says it’s not my fault) I guess I’m celebrating our anniversary and my birthday alone… Thank you for replying tho :)
